Tuya Zigbee 0.3.0 is now available for Test A new Test version of the Tuya Zigbee app, v0.3.0 , has been submitted to the Homey App Store. This release is an important step in getting the app back into active development. Over the past weeks I have been going through the codebase, old pull requests, open and closed issues, device definitions and the overall app structure. The goal with 0.3.0 is primarily to establish a clean and stable modernized baseline before bringing in the larger backlog of device additions and fixes. What is 0.3.0? 0.3.0 includes the modernization work and maintenance needed to create a solid foundation for continued development. It has been validated against the current Homey publish requirements, tested locally on Homey and has passed the automated test suite. I have also tested the app with my own devices and so far it appears as stable as the current Live version. What about all the device requests and old issues? Those are coming next. A separate development branch already contains a large amount of additional work, including support for more Tuya devices, additional fingerprints and fixes for a number of long-standing issues. That work is currently plan

Tuya Zigbee v0.3.1 is now available in Test Hi everyone! Following the modernization work in v0.3.0, I’m happy to announce that Tuya Zigbee v0.3.1 is now available in Test . First, a big thank you to everyone who helped test v0.3.0. With over 2,600 Test installations during its first two days, we’ve had a useful opportunity to observe the updated app in real-world environments. Your feedback, including comments on older GitHub issues and diagnostic reports, has already helped us identify and address additional problems. What’s new in v0.3.1? This is a substantial update, incorporating fixes and improvements recovered from our ongoing review of historical issues, pull requests and device implementations. Highlights include: Support for numerous additional Tuya Zigbee devices and manufacturer IDs. Fixes and improvements for switches, dimmers, remotes and various sensors. Updated handling for several radar, rain, siren and FingerBot devices. Improved Tuya datapoint and Zigbee event handling.
